propositions: The eval/calibration library does not admit activated project code-review criteria; _code_review_prompt_id only accepts static built-in physical ids without repository context
calibrate_criterion lacks a code-review membership branch and maps non-physical ids only through the default plan-review namespace, ignoring project code-review context

_code_review_prompt_id must be extended to accept repo_root as an optional keyword argument and admit logical ids from code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root) mapped via criterion_prompt_id with gate_key="code_review"
calibrate_criterion must conditionally branch to a code-review arm when repo_root is not None and the criterion_id is in code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root)
The code-review arm must catch EvalError from load_eval_spec and re-raise a located EvalError containing the logical criterion_id to aid debugging
Backward compatibility must be preserved: built-in code-review ids admitted without repo_root, plan-review criteria unaffected by non-None repo_root, and inactive project physical ids rejected
